root_cause: Portal Resource Intelligence queries were tenant-scoped, but powerhouse_compliance_evidence_v1 and powerhouse_optimization_candidate_v1 did not carry tenant_id in the live database authority. Historical tests also referenced removed duplicate migration aliases instead of canonical production timestamps.
proven_fix: Add a forward migration that introduces tenant_id on both Resource Intelligence authorities, backfills legacy rows to canonical, and adds tenant indexes.
Generate new optimization candidates only from exact single-tenant business-value authority or the observed resource tenant.
Bind regression tests to canonical production migration timestamps instead of stale duplicate aliases.
prevention: Portal tenant filters and database tenant columns must evolve in the same delivery candidate.
A removed duplicate migration alias must never be reintroduced merely to satisfy a regression test; the test must bind to canonical authority unless the removed file owns unique functionality.
Material Supabase recovery changes require exact-head backend, security, closure evidence and production readback before terminal green.
